High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At Jodhpur S.B. Criminal Revision No. 511

Road, Bhikya Pyaoo, Jodhpur Resident of Inside Sinwanchi Gate, Jodhpur.
----Petitioner Versus State of Rajasthan
----Respondent _____________________________________________________

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Petitioner(s) : Mr.Nishant Bora for Mr.Mahesh Bora For Respondent(s) : Mr.J.P.S.Choudhary,
Public Prosecutor _____________________________________________________ HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE Judgment 05/07/2017
1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Only argument advanced by the learned counsel for the petitioner is that the learned Magistrate and the Court of appeal below did not take note of the definition of the word adulterated as per Section 2 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and the decision of the learned Single Judge of this Court reported as 1992 CRI.L.J. 2233, Fatehlal Vs. State of Rajasthan.
2.
In the instant case the Public Analyst has found the sample of 'coriander' powder adulterated due to presence of 'haldi' powder.
3. The amount of 'haldi' powder in the sample sent for analysis has not been indicated in the report.

4. Noting the definition of adulterated and Rule 26 of the (2 of 2) [CRLR-511/1996] Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules, 1955 as per which 'haldi' is permitted as a colouring agent to be used for the purposes of imparting colour or luster to another food article, in aforenoted decision the learned Single Judge set aside the conviction of Fathelal for having committed offence punishable under Section 7 readwith Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.

5. The facts of the instant case are identical with the facts in Fatehlal's case and thus following the law declared therein, I allow the petition and set aside the decision of the learned Magistrate and acquit the petitioner of the charge framed against him.
The bail bonds and surety bonds are discharged.
The petitioner who is on bail need not surrender.

(PRADEEP NANDRAJOG)CJ.
Kshama Dixit S-26 Moti Lal vs State on 5 July, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35719024/
